content:wysiwyg_basic:11:16.html:
1. Fill out our Volunteer Application for Working with Children
  2. Complete the Background Check (the link will be sent to your email address provided on the application)
  3. Participate in Safe from Harm Training (Our Volunteer Coordinator will contact you once all the forms are completed and approved!)
